reason: I'm one human, so the first five humans are free and I'd pay nothing—but I wouldn't upgrade to $30/seat anyway. My first thought is lock-in: if Loom shuts down, my context is stuck in their daemon, and I switch tools for free tiers constantly.
objection: What happens if Loom shuts down? My context is locked in.
would_change_my_mind: If my sessions and skills lived in plain local files I could take with me instead of being locked into their daemon.
